[[Commander Jafai]] guards the entrance to [[Sunjiang District (outpost)|Sunjiang District]]. He will provide information on what has to be done to gain entrance.

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Shenzun Tunnels}}

==Quests==
'''Quests involved in:'''
*[[Kaineng City]]
**[[City Under Attack]]
**[[Battle in the Sewers]]

==Dialogue==
;Before [[Boreas Seabed]]
:''"This area has been contaminated by the plague and has been quarantined by order of the [[Emperor Kisu|emperor]]. He did mention that a party might come this way, and he suggested I tell you to head to [[Arborstone (outpost)|Arborstone]] or [[Boreas Seabed (outpost)|Boreas Seabed]]. You can get to either of those areas by traveling through the [[Pongmei Valley|Pongmei Foothills]].{{sic}} [Character Name] might want to journey there, first. What else do you wish to discuss?"''

;Between Boreas Seabed and City Under Attack
:''"Once the emperor received word that you had obtained both weapons, an imperial herald was sent to [[Zos Shivros Channel (outpost)|Zos Shivros Channel]]. [Character Name] should head back there to get the royal summons. What else do you wish to discuss?"''

;During City Under Attack
:''"My men have been fighting and dying by the dozens, but the [[Afflicted]] will not stop coming! [Character Name] should talk to the emperor. If I could get some reinforcements, I could help you set up some sort of safe zone within. What else do you wish to discuss?"''

;Between City Under Attack and Battle in the Sewers
:''"Once the emperor received word that you had obtained both weapons, an imperial herald was sent to Zos Shivros Channel. [Character Name] should head back there to get the royal summons. What else do you wish to discuss?"''

;During Battle in the Sewers
:''"I have orders from the emperor to secure this area. No one is to enter or leave the sewers."''

;Default
:''"Please continue on through."''

==Notes==
*He has no dialogue for earlier quests, and will thus misdirect the player if asked then.
